name: Feature request

title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

## Use case

What problem does this solve for you? Describe the scenario, not the solution.

## Proposed solution

How would you like it to work?

## Alternatives considered

What else did you think of, and why is this better?

## Impact

- Does it add a third-party service? (If yes, the user must supply their own
  credentials at runtime, per CONTRIBUTING.md.)
- Does it change the local-first / no-tracking posture?
- Does it change the `.smartpet` format? (If yes, needs a migration path.)
